text.card: A red giant 2,628 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.93 solar masses and 7.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,575 K at its surface.
